daily.today_energy: Mercury's moving through your sector of deep reflection—perfect energy for getting real with yourself. Trust your gut today, Cap. Something's shifting beneath the surface and you're picking up on it.

weekly.overview: This week's energy feels like you're finally shedding a layer you've been holding onto. Mercury's vibe is pushing you toward authenticity—less performative, more real. Trust the quiet inner shifts happening beneath the surface.
weekly.love: Your people can feel when you're being more yourself, and honestly? It's magnetic. Whether you're single or coupled up, vulnerability is your secret weapon rn. Let someone see the softer side you usually keep locked away.
